rows.description: See what is really inside macOS System Data and delete it item by item. A free menu bar app that explains every category and shows each command before it runs.
Free up your Mac. Safely. A free, open-source native Mac app that clears the cache and junk your Mac piles up on its own. Files go to the Trash by default, so you can put them back.
Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux, with duplicate cleanup, app uninstall, startup management, system optimization, and maintenance.

TreeMap is a fully downloadable app that can run on mac, windows, and linux. That visualizeses all of your disk-space into charts and square board. It also lets you delete unwanted files and opens files for you aswell.
Windows disk usage analyzer and cleanup tool with interactive treemaps, large-file discovery, duplicate detection, and file-system monitoring.
Clean Xcode, Docker, Homebrew, and developer caches, remove project and AI artifacts, analyze storage, and reclaim disk space from the Terminal.
